## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests were added or updated.
- [ ] UI changes were checked with mouse, keyboard and a narrow viewport.
- [ ] Simulation changes explain their effect on reproducibility and biological assumptions.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or local-only artifacts are included.

Include screenshots or short clips for visual changes. Note any checks you could not run.
